predecessor_assessment.note: SLICE-0020 (ChatGPT-led external pass) previously recorded identity_seed/production_value as conditional and automated_ingestion as unknown for Catalina Yachts, without resolving the SR-6.6 bounded-manual-use conditions in full. conditions.evidence: All eleven retrieved catalinayachts.com pages/documents returned HTTP 200 with no login/paywall; robots.txt (retrieval 1) disallows only /wp-admin/, which was never accessed.

Only discrete dimension figures (LOA/LWL/beam/draft/displacement), dated production-history facts, and archive link labels were extracted into the retained package. No brochure marketing prose, photography, or drawings were copied; no PDF/HTML/image file was vendored into the repository (source-material retention boundary).
source_retrieval_log.json retains exact URL, access timestamp, HTTP status, byte size and a locally-computed SHA-256 fingerprint for every retrieval, without vendoring the underlying content.

No Terms of Use, Privacy Policy, or licence page exists anywhere in the site's own declared WordPress page sitemap (retrieval 4; 56 pages enumerated, none matching terms/privacy/legal/policy). The footer displays only a bare '© 2026 Catalina Yachts' notice with no reproduction/licence grant or restriction text (retrieval 2). No access restriction beyond /wp-admin/ was found in robots.txt (retrieval 1). This differs materially from source rows such as Beneteau/Wauquiez in archive_source_clearance.json, which carry an explicit anti-extraction Terms-of-Use clause; Catalina Yachts carries no equivalent found restriction.

Exactly two fixed BoatModels were researched using 11 of the 25 permitted retrievals; no attempt was made to enumerate or extract the full brochure catalogue (dozens of unrelated models visible in the brochure-archives/ index were left untouched).

Retrieval was performed as 11 individually issued, human-directed HTTP GET requests, each inspected before the next was requested -- not an unattended crawler/scraper/loop. This satisfies the bounded manual method used in this pilot. It does NOT constitute a clearance of production automated_ingestion, which this assessment leaves unresolved (unknown) exactly as SLICE-0020 left it; see automated_ingestion decision below.
